name: Giant frost arrow with shatter stun

source.title: League of Legends: Ashe, Enchanted Crystal Arrow

phases.name: anticipation
phases.what: bow draws, small frost flash at the nock

phases.name: release
phases.what: oversized arrow flies a long straight line with a long icy wake

phases.name: impact
phases.what: arrow shatters into crystal shards, ice burst on the victim

phases.name: aftermath
phases.what: frost mist and snow motes settle

layers.motion: quick scale pop at the bow

layers.notes: fat head, thin tail; spin the shaft slightly
bright head makes it readable at distance

layers.motion: long ribbon, 1.0s life, taper to zero
shed from tail, drag 2, tiny gravity

whyItLooksGood: one clean line gives a strong read over a long distance
white-hot head against blue tail gives temperature gradient
impact shatter pays off the long flight
buildNotes: Spawn an additive glow sphere head plus a trail ribbon that is 3x longer than the head is wide. Keep arrow speed constant, no wobble. On hit fire a flat ring, 12-20 instanced shard meshes with gravity, and a frost mist emitter. Exaggerate: a 3x oversized head, a ground frost line left along the whole flight path, and a freeze-frame of 0.06s at impact.

name: Channelled wide power arrow

phases.name: anticipation
phases.what: bow draws, wind spirals gather, aim line on ground

phases.name: release
phases.what: wide arrow with pressure wave travels, damage falloff along it

phases.name: impact
phases.what: arrow fades into spray of leaves and air

phases.name: aftermath
phases.what: wind wisps drift off

layers.motion: thin line along aim path, fades in
cone ahead of head, short life

layers.notes: ribbon wide as the hit lane

whyItLooksGood: wide ground telegraph and wide projectile match, so hit area is honest
wind distortion adds speed without extra geometry
long charge then fast release makes a clear beat
buildNotes: Build a long arrow mesh scaled wide in X, a stretched additive glow sphere, and a thick trail ribbon. Use inward-spiral wisps for the charge and a ground line decal. Exaggerate: screen-edge wind streaks during the charge, a 2x wider arrow, and leaves instanced along the path.

name: Spirit dragons pair released from an arrow

phases.name: anticipation
phases.what: Hanzo draws, blue-and-teal spirit energy coils round the arrow

phases.name: release
phases.what: arrow bursts, two dragons spawn out of it

phases.name: impact
phases.what: dragons weave forward in a long line, damaging everything

phases.name: aftermath
phases.what: dragons dissolve into glowing petals and mist

layers.motion: two thick ribbons weaving sine path, 1.2s life
head mesh with horns/jaw at ribbon tip

whyItLooksGood: two interwoven bodies give a spiral that reads as dragon with low cost
cyan with warm white head keeps contrast on any map
a long hold makes the line feel dangerous
buildNotes: Move two ribbon heads along a sine path with phase offset PI (amplitude 1.5, freq 2 Hz) and place head meshes at the tips. Add scale fins as small instanced quads along the body. Exaggerate: 3x wider bodies, a dragon roar flash (screen-flash) at spawn, and a ground scorch along the path.

name: Rocket launcher round with fat explosion

phases.name: anticipation
phases.what: muzzle flash and backblast

phases.name: release
phases.what: rocket flies, smoke trail with flame tail

phases.name: impact
phases.what: big orange fireball and debris

phases.name: aftermath
phases.what: smoke column and lingering sparks

whyItLooksGood: small clean projectile vs huge explosion gives scale contrast
dark smoke on bright fire gives value separation
short anticipation keeps it snappy
buildNotes: Rocket mesh plus smoke emitter dense at the tail and ember emitter. Explosion: stack white core flash, orange glow sphere, flat ring, debris, smoke column rising. Exaggerate: double the fireball size, add a second delayed pop at 0.1s, and a lingering heat distortion.

name: Huge piercing prismatic laser

source.title: League of Legends: Lux, Final Spark

phases.name: anticipation
phases.what: red telegraph line, rainbow energy converges at the staff

phases.name: release
phases.what: beam snaps out to full length

phases.name: impact
phases.what: beam holds, width pulses, ground burned along it

phases.name: aftermath
phases.what: beam thins out, sparkles linger

whyItLooksGood: white-hot core against soft coloured halo is the classic beam look
a red telegraph then sudden full length gives a fast reveal
source flare anchors the beam to the caster
buildNotes: Beam is a stretched additive quad or cylinder with scrolling noise texture along its length, 2 layers at different widths. Snap length in 3-4 frames with an ease-out, then a slight width pulse. Exaggerate: width 2x, a rainbow gradient shift along length, ground cracks along the path.

name: Instant fire-lightning bolt on one target

phases.name: anticipation
phases.what: hand raised, spark gathers at palm

phases.name: release
phases.what: bolt strikes the target instantly

phases.name: impact
phases.what: bright white-blue bolt flickers, red fire at target

phases.name: aftermath
phases.what: sparks and embers fall

whyItLooksGood: very fast release against short build-up makes it feel like a snap
blue-white bolt plus orange fire at hit gives hot/cold split
jitter keeps it alive
buildNotes: Lightning arc between hand and target with jitter re-rolled at 20 Hz; add a straight white core so it never goes thin. Exaggerate: forked branches, a fire pillar at the target, one frame of full-screen white.

name: Three wall-piercing energy bolts in a line

phases.name: anticipation
phases.what: bow equips, charge glow builds, aim marker

phases.name: release
phases.what: first bolt fires, instant long beam

phases.name: impact
phases.what: up to three bolts with short gaps

phases.name: aftermath
phases.what: beam afterimage fades, hit enemies marked

whyItLooksGood: thin hard lines read as a rifle, not a wall of light
three beats give rhythm
rapid fade leaves a clear after-image
buildNotes: Use a thin beam ribbon (width 1.2) with a wider low-alpha halo, firing 3 times 0.4s apart. Fade alpha quickly with ease-out. Exaggerate: width 3x, ground scorch lines, screen flash per bolt.

name: Bouncing frost orb across targets

phases.name: anticipation
phases.what: Lich hands gather frost, cold mist

phases.name: release
phases.what: frost orb launches

phases.name: impact
phases.what: orb bounces from target to target, burst at each

phases.name: aftermath
phases.what: frost clings, snow drifts

whyItLooksGood: each bounce repeats the same strong beat so the chain has a rhythm
a spiky orb reads as ice by silhouette alone
speed rises slightly with every bounce
buildNotes: Orb is a spinning icosahedron mesh with a glow sphere. Move target to target with ease-in (0.35s per hop, shorter each time); at each hop trigger a ring, shards and a frost burst. Exaggerate: 8 bounces, orbs splitting off, frost decals on the ground at each target.

name: Arcing lightning between enemies

phases.name: anticipation
phases.what: hand sparks

phases.name: release
phases.what: bolt leaves hand to the first target

phases.name: impact
phases.what: arcs jump to nearby targets with a delay

phases.name: aftermath
phases.what: sparks fade

whyItLooksGood: the delay between hops lets the eye follow the chain
fork branches give richness at low cost
a node flash at each target shows the hit
buildNotes: Compute target list, draw a lightning arc per hop with a 0.3s delay. Each arc: jagged polyline plus a straight white core. Exaggerate: branches that extend beyond targets, a thunder clap flash, scorch marks.

name: Global multi-strike from the sky

phases.name: anticipation
phases.what: sky flashes, Zeus raises hand

phases.name: release
phases.what: screen flash across map

phases.name: impact
phases.what: a bolt falls from the sky onto each enemy

phases.name: aftermath
phases.what: ground scorch and smoke on each hit

layers.motion: strikes top to bottom in 0.08s, thick 1.5

whyItLooksGood: flashing the whole screen before the strikes sells global scale
instant, thick bolts feel like authority
scorch marks keep the hit visible
buildNotes: For each enemy, spawn a tall thick additive light pillar with a crooked mesh variation, ring, flash, scorch decal. Stagger by 0.05-0.12s. Exaggerate: clouds as dark smoke layer above, 2 bolts per target, thunder flashes lighting the whole arena.

name: Rolling flaming meteor

phases.name: anticipation
phases.what: cast, fiery glow on the staff, sky glows

phases.name: release
phases.what: meteor falls from above at an angle

phases.name: impact
phases.what: crash with fire burst

phases.name: aftermath
phases.what: meteor rolls along the ground, leaving burn trail

whyItLooksGood: dark rock body with bright cracks keeps a silhouette in the fire
the roll after impact extends the effect to a lane
a diagonal fall is more dynamic than vertical
buildNotes: Rock mesh with additive glow sphere and long ribbon. After impact, move along a straight line with ember and smoke emitters, a scorch decal following. Exaggerate: 2x meteor size, impact crater with lava ring, light flicker.

name: Delayed global sunbeam column

phases.name: anticipation
phases.what: ring marker and sun glyph burn into the ground

phases.name: release
phases.what: column slams down

phases.name: impact
phases.what: column holds, scorched ground, blast ring

phases.name: aftermath
phases.what: column fades up, embers fall

whyItLooksGood: long telegraph with a pulse that speeds up builds tension
instant slam beats the telegraph
the column defines the area in height
buildNotes: Rune circle ground ring pulses, then a light pillar mesh with additive gradient drops in 4 frames. Exaggerate: pillar twice as tall, a second inner column, ground cracks with orange glow.

name: Lingering orbital laser

phases.name: anticipation
phases.what: red ring on ground, targeting laser lines in sky

phases.name: release
phases.what: beam arrives from above

phases.name: impact
phases.what: thick red-orange beam sustained, ground burning

phases.name: aftermath
phases.what: beam collapses, smoke

whyItLooksGood: red telegraph clearly marks danger
sustained column signals area denial
tech glyph differentiates from magic
buildNotes: Ground ring decal + rotating chevron rune + tall light pillar with slight flicker. Add embers spiralling up. Exaggerate: orbital muzzle flashes in the sky, twin inner beam, scorched crater increasing in size.

name: Missile carpet barrage

phases.name: anticipation
phases.what: smoke flare lights the target area, jets scream above

phases.name: release
phases.what: missiles dive in a line

phases.name: impact
phases.what: wave of explosions advances along a line

phases.name: aftermath
phases.what: dust, smoke and fire remain

layers.motion: red smoke column from flare, drag 2
explosions step along a line every 0.1s

whyItLooksGood: staggered blasts walking along a line give directed motion
red marker smoke identifies zone before it hits
dust and smoke after build mass
buildNotes: Spawn 12-20 missiles on timed offsets along the line. Each blast: glow sphere, ring, debris, smoke. Exaggerate: double the number of blasts, add secondary cookoff pops and burning wrecks.

name: Spectral dragon sword slashes

phases.name: anticipation
phases.what: sword unsheathed, green glow wraps blade, dragon spirit swirls

phases.name: release
phases.what: wide slash

phases.name: impact
phases.what: repeated slashes with green trails and dragon head

phases.name: aftermath
phases.what: green mist dissipates

whyItLooksGood: bright green is unique in the scene
one big arc per hit makes combat readable
dragon ghost adds mythic feel
buildNotes: Ribbon arc swept by a rotating pivot (0.12s, ease-out), with a crescent mesh. Stretch the glow. Exaggerate: wider arcs, 2 dragon heads at the end of each slash, afterimage, 0.05s hit stop.

name: Leap and crash-landing slam

phases.name: anticipation
phases.what: crouch, ground cracks, dust

phases.name: release
phases.what: leaps up, vanishes into sky, big reticle on ground

phases.name: impact
phases.what: drops in a fireball and slams

phases.name: aftermath
phases.what: shockwave, crater, dust, orange-yellow glow

whyItLooksGood: a long telegraph then a short drop is satisfying
huge ring is readable for allies
dust gives weight
buildNotes: Hide the character at the top, move a fireball with a trail down ease-in 0.35s, then ring, debris, dust, a crater decal. Exaggerate: ring radius 2x, a second delayed ring, rocks flung high.

name: Living bomb countdown and blast

phases.name: anticipation
phases.what: character glows hotter, burning ring on ground shows radius

phases.name: release
phases.what: detonation

phases.name: impact
phases.what: blast expands, stun ring

phases.name: aftermath
phases.what: embers and smoke settle

whyItLooksGood: a long visible fuse is fair and tense
the ring is the exact area
hot flicker scales with time
buildNotes: Animate the ring decal pulse rate and glow sphere scale with t^2. Blast: white flash, fireball, ring, distortion, embers. Exaggerate: character body shaking, 2x radius, a dome shell.

name: Mystic eye sphere that stuns enemies

source.title: Marvel Rivals: Doctor Strange, Eye of Agamotto

phases.name: anticipation
phases.what: runes ignite, arms spread, green glow grows

phases.name: release
phases.what: the great eye opens overhead

phases.name: impact
phases.what: green energy sphere expands, enemies frozen in place, runes spin

phases.name: aftermath
phases.what: sphere collapses into particles

whyItLooksGood: counter-rotating rings give layered magic
dome silhouette marks the area
green is distinct in the scene
buildNotes: Stack a transparent additive sphere (fresnel rim) with 2-3 rotating rune rings at different tilts. Wisps pulled inward. Exaggerate: a giant eye mesh above, time-freeze desaturation, chains of runes.
